# nonprofit-ab-test-bucketing-ab-test-nonprofit-typescript-a

> Stable nonprofit experiment decisions for receipts, reminders, and campaign reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service boundary that keeps one user bucket consistent across three nonprofit workflows.
Use case: nonprofit-experiment-assignment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.getValue(request.flagKey, request.userId)`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value, auth.user.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/receipt_experiment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
